page.notes: Printed "Estq;" is read as "Estq;" with q; for -que. The Greek words ὀνομαλαργὸς, ὀνοματοθέτης and the side-note Greek ὀνομαλοθέτης are hard to read at this scan resolution and are marked [?]. The catchword "timi" is the start of the next page. The text ends with the hyphenated "legi-" and continues on the next page. The chapter title is taken from the printed heading "Cap. 14. De philosophiâ protoplastorum.".
